userGuide.rationale: The range ships the first stable Linux package and Linux update notices. Chapters that described Linux as an experimental Preview-only build, or said a stable Linux package was unavailable, now describe the stable Ubuntu 24.04 deb, its private FFmpeg/FFprobe, manual APT updates, the unavailable Dock and per-application capture, and keep Preview as a subsection. A stale claim that Linux lacks screenshots and recording was corrected. Updater, Dock and Stats behaviour in the range was already described by the commits that introduced it.

website.rationale: The homepage download section and meta description covered Windows and macOS only. It now adds a Linux card and a Linux-first hero button for Linux visitors, resolved from the shared release asset name. GitHub Release installation notes gained a Linux section. Privacy review: no policy change. The range adds no recipient, payload or retention beyond the update checks and optional downloads the 2026-10-16 policy revision already describes; Linux builds make the same latest.json request and never download packages automatically. Effective date retained at 2026-10-16 by maintainer decision on 2026-10-19, because 0.22.0 is the first desktop release shipping that policy revision's update features.
